messages:
maria.k: Heads-up — FinSight is running a set of long offline evals hitting our inference queue, they've queued ~300 8k-token decode jobs and we're seeing admission-control push to 95% in eu-west1. Can we do a temporary per-customer bypass or lower their queue weight?

ops-bot: alert: queue_pressure eu-west1 inference_pool > 0.90 for 12m — active backpressure policy: reject_low_priority (https://internal/metrics/queues/eu-west1)

ben: @maria.k can you paste an example job envelope? also what did sales promise for this pilot (SLA/throughput)?

maria.k: example job: ```json
{
  "customer": "finsight",
  "priority": "high",
  "model": "llama-13b-q4",
  "tokens": 8000,
  "batch_size": 1,
  "type": "eval"
}
``` They claim it's a timeboxed pilot for an analytics integration, not a paid Dedicated commit.

sophia: We generally avoid per-customer bypasses because it breaks fairness. Options: 1) temporary bump queue weight for this customer (cost to platform), 2) route them to a Dedicated trial (need capacity/provisioning), 3) ask them to shard jobs to stay under admission-control.

aj: Capacity snapshot: eu-west1 has 2 spare A100 nodes but those are reserved for infra workloads this week. If we liberate them, infra backlog increases. Link: https://internal/capacity/eu-west1

maria.k: Sales is pushing hard — pilot could convert. They need a one-time 2h exception. Can we do an override with strict token cap and auto-revert? @sophia @aj

leo: We can create an admission-control override scoped to customer_id:finsight. Example API call: ```bash
POST /admin/ac/overrides 
{
  "customer": "finsight",
  "rate": 0.25,
  "expires": "2026-03-18T15:30:00Z",
  "reason": "sales pilot - temporary throughput bump"
}
``` That will relax rejection for a subset of requests but still enforce global pool limits.

sophia: If we do an override, require a tokens cap and audit logging. Suggested payload: add `tokens_cap: 5000000` and `audit: true`. Also add automatic rollback and alert if 95th pct latency > 500ms.

ben: ok with exception if tokens cap + automatic rollback + ops alerted. Who signs off on billing for overage?

sales-east: we can allocate pilot credits — approved up to $2000 to cover any overage. Need finance confirmation later but sales approves now to avoid blocking the demo.

maria.k: I'll submit the override with tokens_cap=5e6, set TTL=2h, and monitor queue. I'll cancel immediately if latency or error rates spike. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: ac_override created id=ovr-20260318-01 by maria.k — expires 2026-03-18T15:30:00Z — tokens_cap=5000000 — audit=true

sophia: Monitoring: watch per-route latency, per-customer token burn, and admission rejections. If we see any regressions, open a P1 channel and revert.

maria.k: Thanks — I'll post a short note after the window with token usage and any anomalies.
